scope: Scene3D owner-validated source closure and request bindings; no rendered pixel or decoded geometry claim

commands.command: python scripts/scene3d_example.py SOURCE; python scripts/render3d.py snapshot-scene --source SOURCE --destination SNAPSHOT; python scripts/render3d.py verify-snapshot SNAPSHOT --adapter scene3d

limitations: Scene3D owner checks document semantics and content hashes, not decoding every geometry format.
No Blender/render backend, image output, GPU execution or production-art approval is established.

acceptance.closure: delegated to authoritative Scene3D load_project before copying and on staged copies
acceptance.selection: exact project/scene/shot versions, shot-to-scene relation, camera, and last sampled time within half-open shot duration
acceptance.negative: missing payload, stale identity, camera mismatch, out-of-range time, existing destination, and corrupt frozen content reject
acceptance.relocation: snapshot verifies and plans after relocation and source removal
